info.name: IRoute - Dynamic Auto Shipment + POD Branching Flow
info.description:
# Dynamic Auto Shipment + POD Branching

## Golden rule
Always run **01a Job Detail** before execute. Pick the next action **only from `allowed_actions`** (ignore timeline green checks). Use **01c JSON** when `requires_multipart: false`, **01b multipart** when true.

## Round-trip (outbound + backload)
Each leg starts at **OA-0001 Start Job** on the **booking** job, then OA-0002→0003→0004 (auto shipment birth), then **shipment** workflow until POD/close. Folder **01** auto-loops through both legs.

## Future-proof — no regeneration when Action Master changes
Action codes and operation impacts are read live from Job Detail on every request. Change codes, resequence steps, or toggle impacts in the portal — **re-run the collection only**.

| Operation impact | Collection variable |
|---|---|
| (next allowed) | execute_action_code |
| auto_shipment_post | execute_use_multipart |
| auto_pod_post | pod_upload_action_code |
| hard_copy_collection | hard_copy_action_code |
| auto_treasury_post + COD | execute_use_cod |

## Run order
**00** Login & sync -> **01** auto-loop workflow until POD -> **02-05** POD, branch, close.
Folder **01** loops via postman.setNextRequest until ready_for_pod=true (max workflow_loop_max, default 30).
If `workflow_stuck=true` (empty allowed_actions), stop — redeploy backend or use a fresh booking.
